fixed.summary:
A style pack's `:root` custom properties are declared once, at the root, and every document inherits their values, as a component's root inherits in a browser instead of matching the page's `:root` again. A token an ancestor sets (`
`) now reaches inside the component; before, the component's root declared the pack's value again over it. A pack's other `:root` declarations (`font-family`, `color`) still apply to every document's root. Parsing a document under a pack no longer copies the pack's several hundred tokens onto it: the 148 built-in documents parse in 494 ms under fantasy, from 1056 ms (release, x86-64).
